name: ALAN Captcha Forms
author: webandco

sections.description:
ALAN Captcha is a privacy-first, GDPR-compliant anti-bot solution that protects WordPress website forms, logins, and more from spam, abuse, and attacks.

It is the ultimate captcha solution to safeguard your website and protect user privacy by utilizing unique crypto puzzles based on a proof-of-work mechanism.

This user-friendly, privacy-preserving reCAPTCHA alternative is easy to install—no technical skills required.
Start protecting logins, forms, and more in minutes. Fully GDPR & WACC compliant!

How ALAN Captcha Works

ALAN Captcha distinguishes between humans and bots using a challenge-response test in the form of unique crypto puzzles, solved by the user’s device. No user action is required.

As a proof-of-work-based anti-bot solution, it is low-friction, cookieless, and provides maximum protection while ensuring compliance with EU data protection regulations.

Benefits

  • Frictionless: Provides frustration-free web experiences for users.
  • Privacy First: No cookies, no user tracking
  • Seamless Integration: Compatible with WordPress Core, Elementor Pro, Contact Form 7, Elementor, and other plugins and themes.
  • Multi-language Support: Available in several languages.

European Accessibility Act Web accessibility by design: No user actions like labeling, writing, or other input are required.

Privacy Notices

ALAN Captcha is compliant with various privacy laws, such as GDPR, CCPA, and others.
Privacy by Design: ALAN Captcha does not use cookies, track users, store personal data.

For more details, please read our privacy policy: ALAN Captcha Privacy Policy

Forms and Plugins Supported

This plugin is compatible with a variety of WordPress forms and plugins.

If a specific plugin is not supported, you can email us or contact the plugin’s authors directly. Adding ALAN Captcha support is usually a quick task for most plugins.

Terms of Service

Our Terms of Service can be found here: ALAN Captcha Terms of Service
sections.installation:
Super quick and easy to get started with ALAN Captcha.

  1. Register at www.alancaptcha.com and generate a Site Key and API Key.
  2. Download and install the plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Enter the Site Key and API Key from your ALAN Captcha account in the plugin settings.
  5. Select the forms you want ALAN Captcha to protect and click Save.

Alternatively, install the plugin manually:

  1. Download the .zip file from the Releases section.
  2. Upload it to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Enter your Site Key and API Key in the General Settings tab (Settings > ALAN Captcha).
  5. Review the settings and enable the desired integrations.
sections.faq:
Do you have a setup guide?

Yes, you can view a setup guide for the plugin at docs.alancaptcha.com.

Where do I find my Site Key and API Key?

You can find your Site Key and API Key on the Dashboard after loging in at my.alancaptcha.com.

Will more integrations be added in the future?

Yes! We continuously improve based on user feedback. If you have suggestions, feel free to submit a support request.

How can I report security bugs?

You can report security vulnerabilities through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team helps validate, triage, and handle security issues.

Where can I get more information about ALAN Captcha?

Visit our website at: www.alancaptcha.com
